Ukraine strikes Russian oil refineries and military sites

Ukraine launched drone attacks targeting two Russian oil refineries and a defense plant in overnight strikes. Russian authorities reported civilian casualties from separate Russian attacks within Ukraine. The Ukrainian president acknowledged strikes on Russian energy facilities, while Russia's president admitted to a fuel shortage following drone attacks on refineries.
